Alias: `pomme rm`.

Delete managed VMs.

```text
pomme delete [NAMES ...] [--force] [--json] [--format FORMAT] [--debug] [--progress PROGRESS]
```

| Argument | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `NAMES` | VM names. Uses `POMME_VM_NAME` when omitted. |

| Flag | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `--force` | Stop running VMs and delete without prompting. May power off if shutdown times out. |

This command also accepts the [common flags](/reference/cli/#common-flags).
